# iosxe_voice_card (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Card configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_card" "example" {
  location = "0/1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `dsp_services_dspfarm` (Boolean) To enable dspfarm service on this voice-card
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `local_bypass` (Boolean) Enable TDM hair pin
